adoption_scope: Guidance and implementation defaults; not media, motion, science, platform or publication approval.

editorial_positioning.scope: Default editorial positioning for unassigned topic discovery, framing and series identity; never overrides an explicit user-commissioned topic.
editorial_positioning.core_proposition: Reveal the hidden physical or structural mechanism behind familiar everyday objects, common devices and observable natural phenomena through concrete visual demonstration.

primary_pillar.focus: Recognizable everyday objects, household or daily devices, packaging, kitchen physics, common materials and everyday safety/mechanical structures identifiable at frame 0.

secondary_pillar.focus: Immediately recognizable natural or physical phenomena framed around a stark concrete contradiction or physical limit (mass, height, force, pressure, phase or scale).

editorial_positioning.question_framing: Lead with a concrete physical or structural contradiction rather than a flat encyclopedia 'how does X work' overview.
editorial_positioning.scope_discipline: Scope each unassigned feed episode tightly to one core visible contradiction and primary mechanism; let clear explanation determine duration without any mandatory floor or ceiling.

design.direction: Route by finished style and commission: local realistic video uses MoneyPrinterTurbo (automatically adding supporting vork 3D/simulation passes when needed), controlled 3D animation uses Blender or vork selected automatically by the agent by mechanism, field/simulation and asset fit, and commissioned cloud production uses Google Flow with paired Chinese and English editions. Effective lighting makes the subject clear and bright, with readable volume/necessary shadows and layered highlights. Background may be light or dark; retain needed shadows and black levels. Render actual exposed finishes finely, with credible structures, scientific relationships and continuous action.
design.design_board_scope: record the actual current board version/hash and reviewed scope; the bundled reference selects appearance only
design.style_reference_scope: legacy_2d_only; not approval for realistic main footage

video_generation.mixed_style: Only within explicit project scope; each segment follows its style route and records its actual production evidence.
video_generation.unavailable_tool: Report the concrete missing capability; fall back automatically from vork to Blender when local ray-query GPU or mechanism fit is absent, and never silently replace a required style route.
video_generation.evidence_boundary: Bind actual MoneyPrinterTurbo assembly, Blender/vork rendering, or Google Flow generation and production evidence according to the route. Media quality requires actual review.

audio.speaker: user_clone
audio.instruct: 用平静、温和而克制的中文口语，像向身边人解释一件事情一样连续讲述。中文默认通过本地 IndexTTS-2.5 个人音色克隆（scripts/synthesize_indextts2.py，使用 <=15 s 私人参考音、duration_factor=1.0、interval_silence=220、paragraph_silence_s=0.55、关闭自动文本情绪 use_emo_text=false）与 #5 人声润色预设（prepare_voice_master.py --polish，mandarin-clone-polish-v1，无混响回声）完成整稿母带，不逐字念、不争辩、不鼓动，严禁短视频营销号反差腔、生造四字缩略词、对称口号式排比或押韵收尾；英文版或云端兜底仍使用 edge-tts（en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural +4% / zh-CN-YunxiNeural +4%）。
audio.runtime_parameters: Default Mandarin across all routes: local IndexTTS-2.5 voice clone (IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2.5, duration_factor=1.0, interval_silence=220, paragraph_silence_s=0.55, use_emo_text=false) via scripts/synthesize_indextts2.py + #5 whole-track speech polish (mandarin-clone-polish-v1) via scripts/prepare_voice_master.py --polish; Microsoft Edge edge-tts handles paired English (en-US-AndrewMultilingualNeural +4%) and cloud Mandarin fallback (zh-CN-YunxiNeural +4%) via scripts/synthesize_edge_tts.py; optional legacy local Qwen applies only when explicitly selected.

speech_polish_preset.scope: default_whole_track_speech_polish_for_local_indextts2_clone_narration; not per visual shot; preserve raw clone source separately
speech_polish_preset.final_mix_policy: config/production-policy.json defaults.mix; whole final encode after music/effects
speech_polish_preset.acceptance: Measured technical result only; timbre/register/joins and final mix require actual listening; no new voice audition for unchanged preferences

mix_preset.scope: new_or_revised_whole_narration_master; not each visual shot; preserve valid accepted audio
mix_preset.final_mix_policy: config/production-policy.json defaults.mix; whole final encode after music/effects
mix_preset.acceptance: Measured technical result only; timbre/register/joins and final mix require actual listening; no new voice audition for unchanged preferences

captions.scale_policy: Same aspect ratio: multiply vertical values by output_height/1920, record rounding; different layout requires review.
captions.exclude: Published or already-approved-for-publication versions are not changed by this setting.
captions.move_scope: Captions and tight background only; document any necessary local label reflow.
captions.scope: legacy_portrait_revision_only; not the default for new landscape work

delivery.default_scope: New productions default to 1920x1080 landscape; preserve approved/published portrait identities and media.

permissions: Follow the current task, version approvals, pauses and cancellations; config adoption grants none.

publication_spacing.scope: Editorial release-spacing guidance to avoid back-to-back self-competition in recommendation feeds; never overrides an explicit user schedule or creates an automated schedule.

platform_sync.scope: Use one Douyin Creator Center video composer for authorized Douyin, Xigua, Toutiao and Fanqie Novel releases. Select the requested native destinations and submit the form once.

video_download.scope: Default to disabled download/save on every destination exposing a control for each authorized future publication, without asking again for the same setting; honor current explicit overrides and enforced approvals, verify actual states, distinguish unavailable/unverified, and never auto-edit published works.

daily_counting.unpublished_inventory: not_automatically_eligible; determine new-work scope from source/version evidence

operations.scope: Historical series planning defaults; apply targets only when the current task requests this production cadence. No task or automation is created by loading this Skill.

video_monetization.scope: For each authorized work enable all eligible per-video revenue and incentive controls supported by the account, work and program, including “广告分成” on Toutiao when available and all eligible options on Xigua Video. Apply this standing preference to routine per-video settings. Report ineligible/unavailable/exclusive choices or new enrollment/identity/payout prerequisites truthfully; do not infer revenue or treat unsupported rights claims and paid promotion as revenue options.

landscape_captions.policy: Design against actual scene and platform, then inspect exported text and tight backgrounds. Never scale legacy portrait Y coordinates into this layout.

shared_3d_library.storage: Versioned copies of editable used assets with dependencies, source/rights, scale/axes, preview and SHA manifest; retain project originals.
shared_3d_library.verification: Read back destination files and compare SHA before claiming archived; unavailable NAS remains local_pending_sync.
shared_3d_library.quality_boundary: Library availability is not current scientific, visual, hearing or publication approval; superseded and rejected variants are not default reusable assets.
shared_3d_library.selection_scope: Find suitable existing models, environments, materials and lighting before creating new ones; a recorded reusable status is limited to its documented scope and never automatic approval for the new film.
shared_3d_library.supporting_assets: Failed and explicitly non-default historical or diagnostic assets are not default choices; searchable using --include-supporting or --status pending/failed.

standing_authorization.policy: Use an actual recorded user grant; preserve local grants when synchronizing maintenance changes. No repeated confirmation within the granted scope.
